headline: Farm Organizations Urge the Board for 150 Million Fund in Direct Aid for Cereals
summary: Farm organisations Asaja, UCCL, UPA and COAG urged the board to approve a 150 million euro fund for direct aid to cereal producers. They also asked the EU to act on cereal imports from Ukraine and Latin America.
why: Cereal prices and import competition shape farm incomes and EU agricultural policy, which determines subsidies and trade protection for producers.
